contents.html: This National Institute of Standards and Technology Interagency Report (NISTIR) is a compendium of computer security training and awareness courses. The purpose of this publication is to assist federal agencies locate computer security training resources. This publication is part of a continuing NIST effort to support federal agencies in accordance with NIST’s mandate under the Computer Security Act of 1987. These courses are organized into training areas within audience categories as defined in NIST Special Publication 500-172, Computer Security Training Guidelines.
contents.html_ja: この国立標準技術研究所省庁間報告書（NISTIR）は、コンピュータセキュリティの研修・意識向上コースの概要集です。本書の目的は、連邦機関がコンピュータセキュリティの研修資源を探す助けとなることです。本書は、1987年コンピュータセキュリティ法（Computer Security Act of 1987）に基づく NIST の責務に沿って連邦機関を支援する、NIST の継続的な取り組みの一部です。これらのコースは、NIST Special Publication 500-172, Computer Security Training Guidelines で定義された対象者区分ごとに、研修分野へ整理されています。
contents.extraction_note: 原本画像と文字層で照合（Claude Opus）。原本画像（PDF p.5）と OCR の文字を語ごとに照合。文末のピリオドの断片を結合（下線の書名は資料全体で書式を付けない）

contents.html: NIST Special Publication 500-172 was developed to provide a framework for identifying computer security training requirements for a diversity of audiences. It focuses on learning objectives based upon the extent to which computer security knowledge is required by an individual as it applies to his or her job function.
contents.html_ja: NIST Special Publication 500-172 は、多様な対象者に対するコンピュータセキュリティ研修の要件を特定するための枠組みを提供するために作成されました。この文書は、個人の職務に応じて、その人にどの程度のコンピュータセキュリティの知識が必要かに基づく学習目標に重点を置いています。
contents.extraction_note: 原本画像と文字層で照合（Claude Opus）。原本画像（PDF p.5）と OCR の文字を語ごとに照合。

contents.html: A training matrix was introduced in Special Publication 500-172 to assist agencies in designing training that meets the learning objectives for a particular group. The training and awareness courses in this compendium have been mapped to the matrix (see appendix A) by the training organization/vendor.
contents.html_ja: Special Publication 500-172 では、特定のグループの学習目標を満たす研修を機関が設計する際の助けとして、研修マトリクスが導入されました。本概要集の研修・意識向上コースは、研修機関・ベンダーによってこのマトリクスに対応付けられています（付録 A を参照）。
contents.extraction_note: 原本画像と文字層で照合（Claude Opus）。原本画像（PDF p.5）と OCR の文字を語ごとに照合。

contents.html: The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) makes no claim or endorsement of the computer security courses or their currency in this compendium. Courses listed in the compendium were sent in as a result of a public data call during the 1991 calendar year. The data call consisted of a letter of invitation to known sources of trainers as provided by the Federal Computer Security Program Managers’ Forum; and the Federal Information Systems Security Educators’ Association. In addition, a CSL Newsletter was disseminated nationwide inviting vendors to participate in this effort. Therefore, this listing is not a complete source of all available security related courses.
contents.html_ja: 国立標準技術研究所（NIST）は、本概要集に掲載されたコンピュータセキュリティコースやその最新性について、いかなる保証も推奨も行いません。掲載されたコースは、1991年の暦年中に行われた公開データ募集の結果として寄せられたものです。このデータ募集は、Federal Computer Security Program Managers’ Forum および Federal Information Systems Security Educators’ Association が提供した、研修担当者の既知の情報源への招待状で構成されていました。加えて、ベンダーにこの取り組みへの参加を呼びかける CSL Newsletter が全国に配布されました。したがって、この一覧は、利用可能なすべてのセキュリティ関連コースを網羅した情報源ではありません。
contents.extraction_note: 原本画像と文字層で照合（Claude Opus）。原本画像（PDF p.5）と OCR の文字を語ごとに照合。下線で分断された 3 断片を結合し、Forum: を Forum; に、Association の後のピリオドを戻す

contents.html: Vendors already listed are encouraged to continue to send in changes/updates and new vendors are invited to send in their computer security courses. (See address below.) NIST expresses its appreciation to the many federal, academic, and vendor organizations that participated in this effort for their time and interest in mapping their courses to the matrix in NIST Special Publication 500-172.
contents.html_ja: すでに掲載されているベンダーには、変更・更新や新しいベンダーの情報を引き続き送付するよう促されています。また、新たなベンダーには、コンピュータセキュリティコースの情報を送付するよう呼びかけています（下記の宛先を参照）。NIST は、NIST Special Publication 500-172 のマトリクスへのコースの対応付けに時間と関心を寄せてくださった、多くの連邦機関、学術機関、ベンダーの組織に謝意を表します。

NIST-114A (REV. 3-90)U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE
NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY
BIBLIOGRAPHIC DATA SHEET
1. PUBLICATION OR REPORT NUMBERNISTIR 4846
2. PERFORMING ORGANIZATION REPORT NUMBER
3. PUBLICATION DATEMay 1992
4. TITLE AND SUBTITLEComputer Security Training & Awareness Course Compendium
5. AUTHOR(S)Kathie Everhart - Editor
6. PERFORMING ORGANIZATION (IF JOINT OR OTHER THAN NIST, SEE INSTRUCTIONS)U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE
NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY
GAITHERSBURG, MD 20899
7. CONTRACT/GRANT NUMBER
8. TYPE OF REPORT AND PERIOD COVERED
9. SPONSORING ORGANIZATION NAME AND COMPLETE ADDRESS (STREET, CITY, STATE, ZIP)
10. SUPPLEMENTARY NOTES
11. ABSTRACT (A 200-WORD OR LESS FACTUAL SUMMARY OF MOST SIGNIFICANT INFORMATION. IF DOCUMENT INCLUDES A SIGNIFICANT BIBLIOGRAPHY OR LITERATURE SURVEY, MENTION IT HERE.)The training and awareness courses in this compendium correspond to the matrix in NIST Special Publication 500-172, Computer Security Training Guidelines. Special Publication 500-172 is used as reference under the OPM regulation that implements Public Law 100-235, the Computer Security Act of 1987, which requires training for all employees responsible for the management and use of federal computer systems that process sensitive information. Under the regulation, agencies will be responsible for identifying the employees to be trained and providing appropriate training.
This publication is divided into five audience categories: 1) Executives, 2) Program/Functional Managers, 3) IRM, Security, and Audit Personnel, 4) ADP Management, Operations, and Programming Staff, and 5) End Users. In addition to the five audience categories, there are five training content areas for each audience category: 1) Computer Security Basics, 2) Security Planning & Management, 3) Computer Security Policy & Procedures, 4) Contingency Planning, and 5) Systems Life Cycle Management. The level of training required in each area will vary from general awareness to specific training courses depending on the training objectives established by each agency.
12. KEY WORDS (6 TO 12 ENTRIES; ALPHABETICAL ORDER; CAPITALIZE ONLY PROPER NAMES; AND SEPARATE KEY WORDS BY SEMICOLONS)computer security; computer security basics; contingency planning; policy and procedures; security awareness; security planning and management; systems life cycle management; training area
13. AVAILABILITY[X] UNLIMITED
[ ] FOR OFFICIAL DISTRIBUTION. DO NOT RELEASE TO NATIONAL TECHNICAL INFORMATION SERVICE (NTIS).
[ ] ORDER FROM SUPERINTENDENT OF DOCUMENTS, U.S. GOVERNMENT PRINTING OFFICE, WASHINGTON, DC 20402.
[X] ORDER FROM NATIONAL TECHNICAL INFORMATION SERVICE (NTIS), SPRINGFIELD, VA 22161.
14. NUMBER OF PRINTED PAGES228
15. PRICEA07

NIST-114A (REV. 3-90)米国商務省
国立標準技術研究所
書誌データシート
1. 刊行物または報告書番号NISTIR 4846
2. 実施組織の報告書番号
3. 刊行日1992年5月
4. 題名および副題コンピュータセキュリティ研修・意識向上コースの概要集
5. 著者Kathie Everhart - 編集者
6. 実施組織（共同の場合、または NIST 以外の場合は、記入要領を参照）米国商務省
国立標準技術研究所
GAITHERSBURG, MD 20899
7. 契約・助成金番号
8. 報告書の種類および対象期間
9. 後援組織の名称および完全な住所（番地、市、州、郵便番号）
10. 補足事項
11. 要旨（最も重要な情報の事実に基づく200語以内の要約。文書に重要な参考文献一覧または文献調査が含まれる場合は、ここに記載します。）本概要集の研修・意識向上コースは、NIST Special Publication 500-172, Computer Security Training Guidelines のマトリクスに対応しています。Special Publication 500-172 は、公法 100-235（1987年コンピュータセキュリティ法）を実施する OPM 規則の下で参照文書として用いられています。この法律は、機微な情報を処理する連邦コンピュータシステムの管理および利用に責任を持つすべての職員に研修を求めています。規則の下では、研修を受ける職員の特定と適切な研修の提供は、各機関の責任です。
本書は、5つの対象者区分に分かれています。1) 経営幹部、2) プログラム・機能管理者、3) IRM・セキュリティ・監査担当者、4) ADP の管理・運用・プログラミング担当者、5) エンドユーザーです。5つの対象者区分に加え、各区分には5つの研修内容分野があります。1) コンピュータセキュリティの基礎、2) セキュリティの計画と管理、3) コンピュータセキュリティの方針と手順、4) 緊急時計画、5) システムライフサイクル管理です。各分野で必要な研修レベルは、各機関が定める研修目標に応じて、一般的な意識向上から特定の研修コースまでさまざまです。

description: 連邦機関がコンピュータセキュリティの研修資源を探す助けとなるよう、研修・意識向上コースをまとめた概要集です。

original_blocks.html: ISdmputer Security Training Awareness Course Compendium
U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE Technology Administration National Institute of Standards and Technology Gaithersburg, MD 20899
Computer Security Training Awareness Course Compendium
U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE Technology Administration National Institute of Standards and Technology Gaithersburg, MD 20899
U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE Barbara Hackman Franklin, Secretary
TECHNOLOGY ADMINISTRATION Robert M. White, Under Secretary for Technology NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY John W. Lyons, Director

This National Institute of Standards and Technology Interagency Report (NISTIR) is a compendium of computer security training and awareness courses. The purpose of this publication is to assist federal agencies locate computer security training resources. This publication is part of a continuing NIST effort to support federal agencies in accordance with NIST’s mandate under the Computer Security Act of 1987. These courses are organized into training areas within audience categories as defined in NIST Special Publication 500-172, Computer Security Training Guidelines

NIST Special Publication 500-172 was developed to provide a framework for identifying computer security training requirements for a diversity of audiences. It focuses on learning objectives based upon the extent to which computer security knowledge is required by an individual as it applies to his or her job function.

A training matrix was introduced in Special Publication 500-172 to assist agencies in designing training that meets the learning objectives for a particular group. The training and awareness courses in this compendium have been mapped to the matrix (see appendix A) by the training organization/vendor.

The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) makes no claim or endorsement of the computer security courses or their currency in this compendium. Courses listed in the compendium were sent in as a result of a public data call during the 1991 calendar year. The data call consisted of a letter of invitation to known sources of trainers as provided by the Federal Computer Security Program Managers’ Forum: and the Federal Information Systems Security Educators’ Association In addition, a CSL Newsletter was disseminated nationwide
inviting vendors to participate in this effort. Therefore, this listing is not a complete source of all available security related courses.

Vendors already listed are encouraged to continue to send in changes/updates and new vendors are invited to send in their computer security courses. (See address below.) NIST expresses its appreciation to the many federal, academic, and vendor organizations that participated in this effort for their time and interest in mapping their courses to the matrix in NIST Special Publication 500-172.

Questions or comments regarding this publication should be addressed to Kathie Everhart, Office of the Associate Director for Computer Security, Computer Systems Laboratory, Building 225, Room B154, National Institute of Standards and Technology, Gaithersburg, MD, 20899.

Additional copies of this NISTIR may be purchased through the National Technical Information Service, Springfield, VA. 22161, telephone: (703) 487-4650. SP500-172 may be purchased through the Government Printing Office, telephone: (202) 783-3238.
U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE 1. PUBUCATION OR REPORT NUMBER
NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY NISTIR 4846
Computer Security Training & Awareness Course Compendium
PERFORMING ORGANIZATION (IF JOINT OR OTHER THAN NIST, SEE INSTRUCTIONS)
U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY
B. TYPE OF REPORT AND PERIOD COVERED
SPONSORING ORGANIZATION NAME AND COMPLETE ADDRESS (STREET, QTY, STATE, ZIP)
ABSTRACT (A 200-WORD OR LESS FACTUAL SUMMARY OF MOST SIGNIFICANT INFORMATION. IF DOCUMENT INCLUDES A SIGNIFICANT BIBUOGRAPHY OR UTERATURE SURVEY, MENTION IT HERE.)
The training and awareness courses in this compendium correspond to the matrix in NIST Special Publication 500-172, Computer Security Training Guidelines Special Publication

500-172 is used as reference under the 0PM regulation that implements Public Law 100-235, the Computer Security Act of 1987, which requires training for all employees responsible for the management and use of federal computer systems that process sensitive information. Under the regulation, agencies will be re\sponsible for identifying the employees to be trained and providing appropriate training.

This publication is divided into five audience categories: 1) Executives, 2) Program/ Functional Managers, 3) IRM, Security, and Audit Personnel, 4) ADP Management, Operations, and Programming Staff, and 5) End Users. In addition to the five audience categories, there are five training content areas for each audience category: 1) Computer Security Basics, 2) Security Planning & Management, 3) Computer Security Policy & Procedures, 4) Contingency Planning, and 5) Systems Life Cycle Management. The level of training required in each area will vary from general awareness to specific training courses depending on the training objectives established by each agency.
